title: ESOExporter topic tree, version 1
description: The shape of tree.json: everything a user can switch on or off, as a tree of groups and topics. A group only gates the nodes below it. A topic is a leaf and is one stored entry, keyed by its id. Rules a schema cannot state (ids unique, each id its parent's id plus one segment, a topic's scope equal to its root's id) are checked by the tests and by the Lua loader.

nodes.description: The roots. Today they are the two scopes, account and character.

id.description: The full dotted path from the root, in snake_case. A topic's id is also its storage key under topics, so export.schema.json applies this same pattern to topic keys.

scope.description: Where the entry is stored: under account.topics, or under characters[<id>].topics.

cost.description: heavy topics are large or slow, are off by default and run only when asked for.
